title: A Dataset for Metaphor Detection in Early Medieval Hebrew Poetry
findings: The paper found that transformer-based models adapted to the target genre are crucial for understanding historical religious texts. Specifically, BEREL, pre-trained on ancient Jewish texts, outperformed AlephBERT, pre-trained on modern Hebrew, for metaphor detection in medieval Hebrew poetry. This highlights the importance of domain-specific pre-training for specialized tasks on religious and historical corpora. The best model achieved an F1 score of around 49.
